name: Compartment, export and membrane-access feature tables
description: Expose exact sequence/topology features and source-controlled access/orientation readouts so export, processing, physical access and downstream assembly can be compared as distinct measured properties.

capability_operations.operation: Inspect declared signal or transmembrane sequence features

inputs.features: explicit source feature annotations or declared local motif/length rule

outputs.feature_table: residue windows, charge/motif/leader lengths and rule matches

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

capability_operations.operation: Predict topology or export signals under a supplied model

outputs.predictions: segment/signal positions, orientation and model confidence where provided

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

inputs.source_observations: identified reporter accessibility, processing band, fractionation, leakage/orientation controls and assembly/output records
inputs.keys: construct, compartment treatment, temperature and membrane preparation

outputs.table: separate access/processing/assembly/output fields and exact controls
outputs.unknowns: unmapped cleavage sites, unexpressed hybrids and unresolved orientation

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

repository_catalog_defined: public.uniprot.record, material.annotations and sequence.align/sites can provide source features and selected residue correspondences; no specific SignalP/TMHMM/DeepTMHMM/FlaFind callable confirmed.
research_operations_performed: spatial/archaeal_processing/investigation.json: exact selected leader-length panel and six-pilin-minus-2-residue rule audits from published records. No full FlaFind rerun or de-novo topology prediction.
capability_specifications_not_confirmed_: Topology, export-signal prediction and genome-scale pilin discovery require a supplied implementation; existing annotations are source assertions.
author_experiments_are_source_evidence_o: Spheroplasts, membrane vesicles, reporter fusions, protease/alkylation access, localization, processing and filament assays are author experiments.
availability.binding_limit: A repository catalog definition is confirmed source-code identity, not proof of caller enablement, service availability, installed dependencies or execution in this research. Research scripts are retained operations, not registered runtime tools.

limits: Processing-band shift need not identify the exact cleavage site or restore downstream assembly.
Predicted orientation and reagent accessibility are different observations; vesicle orientation/leakage and burial controls matter.
An unexpressed hybrid cannot establish an assembly-specific defect; heterologous membrane preparation/temperature limits transfer.

observed_uses.use: Actual leader-length rule audit showed LP5 positive/LP6 negative for FlaK, defeating a length-only explanation; PibD results had different preparation/temperature.
observed_uses.execution_scope: Selected nine-member panel, not classifier validation; length 11 not tested.

observed_uses.use: Processing-positive PilA1 hybrid lacked pili/adhesion while an unexpressed PilA3 hybrid could not isolate assembly failure.
observed_uses.execution_scope: Author experiments; six-pilin rule audit adds no native cleavage-site or filament-composition measurement.

observed_uses.use: Orientation-controlled cysteine accessibility revised an opposite-face static model while leaving the complete transport cycle unresolved.
observed_uses.execution_scope: Published alkylation/vesicle experiments; no new topology prediction.

observed_uses.use: Membrane disruption restored substrate cleavage after MurJ inhibition whereas outer-membrane removal did not, making access controls decisive.
observed_uses.execution_scope: Author experiments; no purified transport repetition.

observed_uses.use: Functional export/targeting fusions separated Tat-dependent processing from AmiC septal concentration and induced rescue.
observed_uses.execution_scope: No direct binding target or mandatory targeting claim.

observed_uses.use: Exported thioredoxin function required genotype correction and DsbB-dependent reoxidation rather than localization alone.
observed_uses.execution_scope: Author pulse-chase and redox assays; high-expression interpretation remains proposed.
